requirements.evidence: All contract members are present: Queues properties and methods (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:23-305) and view data accessQueue/accessGrants (Queues.php:296-301). Rename re-derives the slug with `slug: Str::slug($this->renameName)` (Queues.php:194). The toggle uses a confirmation modal, not wire:confirm (queues.blade.php:96-118). Serve has a #[Locked] lastCalledTicketId, catches Inactive/NoWaiting, leaves AuthorizationException uncaught and rate-limits only successful calls (Serve.php:73-109). The waiting list is ordered priority desc, issued_at, id with limit 30 (Serve.php:134-147). Members has activeTab/setActiveTab with a whitelist (Members.php:57-82) and the invite box sits only under `@if ($tab === 'invites')`. Both routes, navbar links and every listed lang key exist in en and pt_BR. Small doubt: the queues view has no explicit @error for name/renameName, so showing the error depends on <x-input>.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes go through CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket. Authorization uses policies (`$this->authorize('manageAccess', $queue)`). #[Validate] is used on name, renameName and mode. Markup is Bulma, matching the members page. CHANGELOG is updated under Unreleased. Deviations: Members::$activeTab is a public client-writable property with no #[Validate] (it is normalized in the view instead, members.blade.php:6), and action parameters are untyped (`openQueue($queueId)`).

security.evidence: Every client id is resolved through `$this->entity->queues()->findOrFail(...)` (Queues.php:274) or `$this->entity->memberships()->findOrFail(...)` (Queues.php:266), and every mutating action re-authorizes. render() looks up viewing/accessQueue scoped to the entity, so a foreign accessQueueId yields null and an empty collection (Queues.php:281-292). In Serve, the entity and lastCalledTicketId are #[Locked], mode is validated, the selected queue is read only from callableQueues() (Serve.php:153) and calls are rate-limited per user and entity. All output uses {{ }}. No weakness found.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Entity/QueuesTest.php, ServeTest.php, QueueNavigationTest.php and new MembersTest cases cover happy paths, validation failures, duplicate-slug errors, tamper tests (foreign queue/membership -> ModelNotFoundException, a foreign accessQueueId discloses nothing, locked lastCalledTicketId -> CannotUpdateLockedPropertyException), unauthorized calls (employee 403, manager demoted after mount), the rate limit, mode filtering, the 30-ticket cap, and translations in both locales. Existing invite tests were updated to the new tab behaviour, not weakened (EntityInviteTest.php:179-188).

simplicity.evidence: Lean components that reuse the domain actions. Queue resolution is centralized in scopedQueue(), and grant/revoke share setAccess(). Small waste: render() always loads every membership with users (Queues.php:300) even when the access modal is closed. The status tag markup is duplicated between the list and the detail modal.

readability.evidence: Clear names and short methods. Each public property has a PHPDoc explaining its trust level (e.g. 'Untrusted client state — always re-resolved scoped to the entity'). Blade follows the members page structure with box/modal comments. No dead code or debug output.

scope.evidence: Every file serves the task: two components, their views, routes, navbar, lang keys, members tabs, tests and the CHANGELOG. The only extra items are supporting lang keys (serve_rate_limited, mode labels), which the UI needs.

issues.explanation: The create and rename forms have no explicit @error output for name/renameName, so whether domain errors are actually shown depends on the unshown <x-input> component.
public string $activeTab is client-writable but has no #[Validate]/#[Locked]. The view normalizes it, but the project policy asks for validated public properties.
Action parameters such as $queueId are untyped. An array payload would make findOrFail return a collection and cause a TypeError (500) instead of a clean not-found.
Memberships with users are queried on every render even when the access modal is closed.

review.summary: The change adds the Queues management and Serve components with views, routes, navbar links, members tabs and bilingual strings. It routes all writes through the domain actions, scopes every client id to the entity and ships thorough tests, including tamper, unauthorized-call and rate-limit cases. Only minor points remain: error display relies on <x-input>, activeTab is not validated, and parameters are untyped. I would approve it with nits.
